Done. Final state is clean — the ~300 PNGs in the repo root are tracked files from prior runs, not mine (my screenshot went to `C:/tmp`).

## UI Consistency Audit — Run 98

Prior runs recorded that the seven static audits (icons, buttons, headers, sidebar, forms, spacing, modal shells) are **converged**, and named the open gap: *modal interiors* — "a violation inside an unopened modal is invisible to every runtime sweep run so far." I took that gap, and it produced **both** defects.

### Two defects found and fixed

**`aff13c2` — 16 of 22 modal close buttons had no box at all.** The six slide-over closes use `.slide-over__close` (32×32, flex-centred, with a hover background). Every `.modal-backdrop` dialog hand-rolled its own inline and set no size, so each collapsed to its bare icon: an **18×18–20×23 non-square** hit target, at three different offsets, with **no hover feedback anywhere**. Added `.modal-close` — the same box minus the absolute positioning, since backdrop modals put their close in a flex header row. All 22 now measure **32×32 at dTop 25/dRight 25** with a working, reverting hover.

The inline chrome those buttons carried was already redundant (`index.css:91` supplies it) — and the inline `background:'none'` was exactly why a hover state could never have been added.

**`18837f7` — an inline style killed one button's hover.** `SubcontractorsView.jsx:261` carried `className="slide-over__close"` *and* an inline style re-declaring `background:'none'`. Inline beats a stylesheet rule regardless of specificity, so `.slide-over__close:hover` could never apply. Static analysis passes this — the class is applied, the CSS is defined. The tell was runtime: `matches(':hover') === true` while the background stayed transparent.

That's the fourth consecutive run whose defect is "a declaration silently loses the cascade."

### Regression pass — clean on 18 routes
Zero foreign SVGs (43/43 imports are `24/outline`), topbar 56px+glass 18/18, one `<h1>` 18/18, nav 18/18 with identical gaps, **0 native selects, 0 date inputs** in source *and* runtime, 0 overflow, 0 overlays at rest. Every button-radius outlier maps to an already-documented family.

### One thing I did not fix
**Form label drift is real**: canonical is `.form-group label` (12px/600/uppercase/0.08em); `/tasks` and `/subcontractors` match, but `/work-orders` is `12px/600/none/normal` and `/expenses` is `12px/400/none/normal`. Scope is 4 `labelStyle` objects plus ~100 inline `<label>` across 19 files. A prior run recorded this as "deliberately not half-converted," and I agree — a subset conversion adds a new inconsistency axis, and converting all ~100 is a refactor, which this charter excludes. It's documented with the full scope and canonical target as a developer decision.

Build PASS (7.99s). **Net DB writes: 0** — every non-GET request was stubbed for the whole session. Full record at `C:/tmp/ui-audit-results.txt`; memory and gotchas updated, including a new trap that cost me two turns: **component files have mixed line endings**, so a multi-line `\n` patch silently misses every CRLF file.
